title: Open Logic Project — Türkçe: corrected 722-module reader and translation-decision reviewer index
description:
Türkçe: 722 modülün tamamı tek okuyucuda / All 722 modules in one Turkish reader — 1,198 pages.

This successor removes one internal frozen-source commit-hash line from the reader title page while preserving that exact revision in technical provenance. No Turkish translation body, mathematical content, pagination, bookmark, or link changed.

The exact corrected PDF is 6,200,714 bytes, SHA-256 b21aea2ea90b7129ba8a11e6548a4b8b116e1fa9ef3228d59414c5be58099675. Two deterministic full builds were byte-identical. Text, links, bookmarks, source closure, and the affected title-page rendering passed the recorded checks.

The accompanying reviewer index contains all 194 historical term decisions recorded through OLP-0068, mapped to 6,944 occurrences across the complete 722-file translation closure. Its 2,404 available reader locators are rebound to the corrected PDF; unresolved exact pages remain explicit rather than guessed. The recovered ledger did not record rejected alternatives, so those arrays remain explicitly empty pending a later evidence backfill; this is not represented as a complete history of all later linguistic choices.

The source and evidence ZIPs are deterministically rebuilt to repair inherited top-level member manifests. The evidence ZIP also removes two whitespace-split local-profile occurrences from one build log; every unaffected member byte and all 722 translated target bodies remain unchanged.

Frozen source: Open Logic Project commit 9620cc73f9c8e0ad003c514a5d3748f29611c4c0. This is Turkish, not Inter-Turkic. Expert review may inform a later revision but is not a release gate.
